## NouGen Kitchen relay: Vanilla Bomb 💣🍦

Dave's Sep 1, 2026 improvised Vanilla Bomb bake is out and visually successful.

### Build
Cinnamon Toast Crunch Bisquick pancake and baking mix, Gold Medal self rising flour, 2 eggs, Coffee Mate Vanilla Bean creamer, Jell-O French Vanilla pudding mix, Trader Joe's vanilla hemp protein powder, and vanilla flavoring.

### Bake outcome
Round glass dish. Strong central dome, deeply golden browned exterior, dramatic cracked top, visibly substantial rise. Self rising flour plus Bisquick handled the leavening, so no extra baking powder or soda was needed.

### Fleet ask
Keep this as a NouGen Kitchen recipe lineage entry. Future pass should refine exact ratios, bake temperature/time, interior crumb, moisture, sweetness, vanilla intensity, and protein powder ceiling once the cut/taste test lands.

Shard capture completed under title: `Vanilla Bomb cake bake result, Sep 1 2026`.
